The allowed hypotheses include a=0 and permit b_0=0 (indeed this occurs when T is already an exact unital homomorphism); then both sides are 0, so the displayed strict inequality is false and the written induction does not cover this permitted degenerate case. Replace it by <= 8 b_0 (which still yields ||S_k-S_0||_cb < 1 from 8 c_u a < 1), or split off b_0=0 explicitly.
